messages:
nora.support: quick flag - customer 'lighthouse' onboarding hit bulk-embed failures during CSV ingest. seeing 429s + a few 502s, renewal touch in 7 days. :warning:
diego.cs: thanks. hosted or private? any error snippets and rate profile?
nora.support: Hosted. burst ~180 reqs/min from their import job. sample error:
```
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"concurrency_limit", "tenant":"acct-lighthouse"}
```
retries piling up in SDK and some 502s observed.
arya.eng: likely per-tenant concurrency default hit. short mitigations: 1) temporary concurrency override to 48, 2) enable burst pool for tenant, 3) advise customer to throttle parallel workers. ops can apply override?
diego.cs: CS will own customer comms. Mike (AM) any commercial suggestion?
mike.am: offer 1-week extension or small credit; prefer we fix before renewal convo. need cost delta for override.
ops-bot: Applying quota override for acct-lighthouse: concurrency=48, burst=true. change id: q-2026-10-02-02
nora.support: applied. telemetry: 429s dropped to ~1.2%, 502s nearly gone. p95 latency down from 2.1s to 650ms. single timeout during switch.
diego.cs: CS comms plan: 1) immediate note with apology, mitigation summary and owner contact; 2) 30m tech sync within 24h (eng+support); 3) offer 1-week extension + feedback form; 4) follow-up RCA and playbook for bulk imports. I'll draft message now.
arya.eng: RCA bullets for customer doc: - Cause: bulk parallel uploads exceeded tenant concurrency, causing queueing and worker timeouts. - Mitigation: temporary quota bump + burst pool. - Next steps: tenant-aware autoscaler and SDK client-side throttling.
diego.cs: owners: CS (diego) send note + invite; Support (nora) monitor override; Eng (arya) provide RCA draft 48h; AM (mike) handle renewal gesture; Ops retain override until fixed (q-2026-10-02-02).
mike.am: invited customer to 2026-10-03 09:00 UTC tech sync. invites sent.
diego.cs: marking P1 (renewal-watch). will close after RCA + postmortem + feedback captured. :white_check_mark:
